EmbodiedMind

VLM-Guided Embodied Agent with Hierarchical Planning and Episodic Memory in MineDojo

2026

A Minecraft agent that plans with a language model, sees with a vision-language model (VLM), and remembers past episodes. It runs on MineDojo.

Year
2026
Code
embodied-mind on GitHub ↗
Runs on
MineDojo; a local 7B vision model or Gemini / OpenAI
Status
The full loop runs end to end on real MineDojo
License
MIT

Code on GitHub ↗

Each step the agent looks at the game frame, recalls similar past episodes, asks the planner for an ordered list of subgoals, and turns the current subgoal into a game action. The full loop runs end to end on real MineDojo; larger models and longer runs are next.
